passives.name: Merciless God
passives.description: (Passive Effect) Increases Counterattack Chance by 50%. Inflict Cursed on all enemies at the start of each turn for [Buff_T_licence_upgrade6] turn(s). Reduces damage taken from skills other than Burst Skills, Dual Attacks, and Skill Chains by [Buff_V_licence_upgrade7], and reduces Weakness Gauge damage taken by [Buff_V_licence_upgrade8] when not Enraged.
